proposedChanges.name: Arete Outdoor Centre
proposedChanges.tagline: Multi-activity residential outdoor centre on the edge of Snowdonia
proposedChanges.description: Arete Outdoor Centre is a not-for-profit, AALA-licensed multi-activity residential centre based in Llanrug, a village 3 miles east of Caernarfon in North Wales. Set between the mountains of Eryri (Snowdonia) and the Anglesey coastline, the centre runs rock climbing, coasteering, kayaking, gorge scrambling, bushcraft, and more for schools, youth groups, families, and adults. Formerly Llanrug Outdoor Education Centre (operated by Worcestershire Council for over 35 years), it was taken over in 2014 by staff who formed an independent non-profit. It holds an AALA licence, Adventuremark accreditation, the LOtC Quality Badge, and a 3-star Visit Wales residential grading. Sleeping up to 118 across three buildings, it offers group packages including Duke of Edinburgh Award expeditions, summer camps, and NGB instructor training.
